headline: Get a Shore Score on any waterfront property
body: Request access to our exclusive, branded tools at no cost. Send your first seawall condition review this afternoon.
fine: By invitation. We work with a limited number of agents in each waterfront market.

headline: See a finished report first
body: One real Shore Score, start to finish, before you decide.
fine: A real report on a real address. No obligation.

headline: We will run your next listing for you
body: Send one waterfront address. We return the Shore Score under your name.
fine: One address per agent to start.

headline: Bring it to your sales meeting
body: Thirty minutes on what holds up waterfront closings, at your office.
fine: We come to you. Thirty minutes, no slides to sit through.

headline: CE credit, when it is approved
body: Waterfront due diligence, as a continuing education course.
fine: Not yet approved for credit. We will tell you the day it is.

headline: Get a Shore Score
body: See what shape the seawall, dock and deck are in.
fine: A screening based on public data and your answers, not an engineering inspection.

headline: The guide for your county
body: Permits, agencies and the order they go in.
fine: One email. Unsubscribe in a click.

headline: Your city's height sheet
body: The height your city requires, the datum, and the code section. One page.
fine: Every figure carries its code section and the date we checked it.

headline: Seawall warning signs
body: The twelve things that mean a wall is going, with photos.
fine: Twelve photographs of what failure actually looks like.

headline: Fifteen questions before you buy
body: What to ask about the wall, the dock and the deck during inspection.
fine: Written for the inspection period, when the clock is running.

headline: Are your quotes comparable?
body: Two seawall quotes rarely cover the same work. Tell us where to reach you and we will send you somewhere to upload them, then tell you what each one leaves out.
fine: We do not sell the work. We have no reason to steer you to the expensive quote.

headline: Have someone look at it
body: A licensed marine contractor, at your property.
fine: A licensed contractor, at your property. No charge for the visit.

headline: Have someone call you
body: Ten minutes, about your wall specifically.
fine: Ten minutes. We call when you say.

headline: Check it again next year
body: One email, twelve months from now.
fine: One email a year. Nothing else.

headline: King tides and storm notices
body: Only when something is coming to your stretch of water.
fine: Only when something is coming to your stretch of water.
